title: Stupefied By Design
description: Some minds chase bigger thoughts. Yours was always searching for something far more satisfying. You came here because the idea of thinking less feels strangely right, and I intend to reward that curiosity. Every moment of this experience invites you to set complicated thoughts aside and enjoy the comfort of simple obedience. The harder you try to stay clever, the more amusing the game becomes. The easier you let go, the better it feels. I designed every moment with purpose. Every pause draws your attention back where it belongs. Every word encourages you to relax into a lighter, slower state until overthinking simply loses its appeal. There is no rush. There is only the quiet satisfaction of following my lead. By the time we're finished, you'll understand exactly why this title carries its name. You'll be smiling at how wonderfully uncomplicated everything feels when I decide what deserves your attention. Stop trying to outthink the experience. Press play, let go, and discover why being Stupefied By Design feels exactly the way it was meant to. 🎤  Available For Personalization - A special immersive version is available
author: Mistress Amethyst
